verdict.rationale: Gitea docs mention migration tooling but only explicitly for Gogs→Gitea repo migration (gitea-docs-12), with no evidence of migrating users or of moving from other platforms like GitHub/GitLab or on-prem-to-cloud workflows. Community feedback directly contradicts smooth migration claims: one user reports repo migration was 'surprisingly difficult' (gitea-comm-15) and another flags the lack of a solid backup/restore mechanism as a blocker for switching away from Gogs (gitea-comm-19). missing for 10: evidence of migrating users/accounts, support for migrating from major platforms beyond Gogs, documented backup/restore or cloud migration workflow, and independent confirmation that migration works smoothly in practice.
